property_summary: For any caller, invoking DrugDealer() always sets ceoAddress to msg.sender (so subsequent seedMarket() call by that ceo can set initialized=true); the mutant breaks this because seedMarket no longer sets initialized=true, so initialized may remain false after the sequence, making the invariant 'if caller called DrugDealer(), then c.ceoAddress()==caller implies c.initialized()==true after seedMarket by that ceo' false for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the assignment to initialized by replacing it with no-op (a redundant assignment to itself), effectively preventing initialization change (keeps previous value).
